descriptions.zh:
太空海盗！即使他们这种想法也令人兴奋，这个自称为§S[pirate_band.GetName]§!的团体把目光转向了我们。

虽然我们可以尊重他们选择的生活方式，但这对我们贸易网络产生的影响可不太理想。
descriptions.en:
Space pirates! Even the thought is a thrill, and a group calling themselves §S[pirate_band.GetName]§! have turned their sights on us.

While we can respect their choice of lifestyle, the effect it's having on our trade networks is less ideal.

descriptions.zh:
一群逃兵与叛徒在§H[pirate_system.GetName]§!星系安了家。这些亡命之徒驾驶着偷来并经过改装的舰船从我们的编队中溜走，如今正掠夺着维持我们航程的贸易航线。他们自称为“§S[pirate_band.GetName]§!”，并发誓不效忠于任何旗帜。

他们出身于舰队，对我们的舰船、航线和行动模式了如指掌。绝不能任由他们继续壮大。
descriptions.en:
A band of deserters and renegades has made its home in the §H[pirate_system.GetName]§! system. Slipping away from our formation in stolen and modified vessels, these outcasts now prey upon the trade lanes that sustain our journey. They call themselves the "§S[pirate_band.GetName]§!" and have sworn to answer to no flag.

They are fleet-born, and know our ships, our routes, and our patterns. They must not be allowed to grow any stronger.

descriptions.zh:
由于觊觎我们恒星系之间不断增长的贸易，一大群源自[Root.Capital.GetName]的叛教匪徒已经将一些民船非法改造成了战争武器。这些异端自称为“§S[pirate_band.GetName]§!”，并对我们在§S[pirate_system.GetName]§!恒星系内的不设防贸易路线发起了数次袭击。

我们不能容忍他们继续这种亵渎行为！
descriptions.en:
As interstellar trade between our systems continues to grow, a large group of faithless criminals from [Root.Capital.GetName] have illegally converted a number of civilian starships into weapons of war. These heretics have started calling themselves the "§S[pirate_band.GetName]§!" and are responsible for several attacks against our vulnerable trade routes in the §S[pirate_system.GetName]§! system.

Their profane activities must not be allowed to continue!

descriptions.zh:
据舰队情报机构报告，在上几个月里，我们境内的民间货船遭到数起袭击。袭击者似乎是源自[Root.Capital.GetName]的逃兵以及其它叛徒。

这些匪徒已经用大幅改装的民船组建了一支临时舰队，并正在§H[pirate_system.GetName]§!恒星系劫掠我们不设防的贸易路线。他们自称“§S[pirate_band.GetName]§!”。尽管他们的舰船非常简陋，但仍是个不可忽略的威胁。
descriptions.en:
Naval Intelligence has reported several attacks on civilian shipping in our space within the last several months. The perpetrators appear to be deserters and other renegade elements from [Root.Capital.GetName].

These criminals have put together a makeshift space fleet out of heavily modified civilian hulls and are preying on our vulnerable trade routes in the §H[pirate_system.GetName]§! system. They now call themselves the "§S[pirate_band.GetName]§!." Although crude, their vessels are a clear threat that cannot be ignored.

descriptions.zh:
我们社会中某些疯狂的不法分子离开了[Root.Capital.GetName]，并在宇宙的偏僻角落里开始亡命生涯。这些歹徒出人意料地手巧，对许多民用飞船进行了大幅改造并武装了起来。

我们位于§H[pirate_system.GetName]§!恒星系内的贸易路线没有设防，并开始遭到这支自称“§S[pirate_band.GetName]§!”的简陋舰队的劫掠。我们必须迅速对此做出回应。
descriptions.en:
Certain irrational and criminal elements of our society have left [Root.Capital.GetName] to seek an outlaw's life in the far reaches of space. In a display of surprising ingenuity, these brigands have heavily modified and weaponized a large number of civilian starships.

Our vulnerable trade routes in the §H[pirate_system.GetName]§! system are now being raided by this improvised starfleet, which identifies itself only as the "§S[pirate_band.GetName]§!." A prompt response is needed.

descriptions.zh:
我们的一些商人发来了令人担忧的报告。自从我们发展出太空旅行科技以来，[Root.Capital.GetName]上的边缘群体就不断离开我们的母星，摒弃了我们的和平社会。

这些误入歧途者自称“§S[pirate_band.GetName]§!”，并将数艘民用飞船改造成了战舰。现在他们成了海盗，在§H[pirate_system.GetName]§!恒星系内洗劫我们不设防的贸易路线，他们肆无忌惮的攻击已经造成了许多伤亡。或许有必要采取极端措施来保护我们的人民。
descriptions.en:
Alarming reports are coming in from some of our traders. Since we developed space travel, violent fringe groups on [Root.Capital.GetName] have departed our homeworld in increasing numbers, spurning the peaceful ways of our society.

These misguided individuals call themselves the "§S[pirate_band.GetName]§!" and have converted several civilian vessels into warships. Living as pirates, they now prey on our vulnerable trade routes in the §H[pirate_system.GetName]§! system and their wanton attacks have led to many deaths. Drastic measures may be needed to protect our people.

descriptions.zh:
逃离[Root.Capital.GetName]的叛党与歧见者已将数艘民船改造成战舰，组建了一支匪徒舰队。这些恐怖分子自称“§S[pirate_band.GetName]§!”，并正在我们位于§H[pirate_system.GetName]§!恒星系的不设防贸易路线上散播混乱与恐怖。

这些罪大恶极的匪徒死有余辜。我们必须不惜一切代价恢复秩序。
descriptions.en:
Rebels and dissidents fleeing from [Root.Capital.GetName] have founded an outlaw space fleet by modifying several civilian vessels into warships. Calling themselves the "§S[pirate_band.GetName]§!," these terrorists are spreading chaos and fear along our vulnerable trade route in the §H[pirate_system.GetName]§! system.

Their lives have been rendered forfeit by the enormity of their crimes. Order must be restored, at any cost.

descriptions.zh:
寄生虫永远都会涌向新的市场，企图侵害他人以谋一己之利，在太空中也不例外。[Root.Capital.GetName]上的几个地下犯罪组织已将一小批货船改造成了战舰，将黑手伸向了太空。

这些犯罪分子自称“§S[pirate_band.GetName]§!”，而他们的舰船已开始在§H[pirate_system.GetName]§!恒星系内打劫我们不设防的贸易路线。我们应该在事态恶化之前迅速采取行动。
descriptions.en:
Parasitic elements always flock to new markets, seeking to cut into profits at the expense of those doing honest business - space has proven no different. Several underground criminal organizations on [Root.Capital.GetName] have expanded their operations into space by converting a small fleet of civilian freighters into warships.

The outlaws call themselves the "§S[pirate_band.GetName]§!" and their ships have started menacing our vulnerable trade route in the §H[pirate_system.GetName]§! system. We should act quickly before the situation gets out of hand.

descriptions.zh:
随着民间太空旅行变得越来越普遍，[Root.Capital.GetName]上的数个强大的犯罪组织也发现了新的机会。他们将一小批民用货船改造成了自制战舰，并用它们来打劫商船的货物。

我们得知他们自称为“§S[pirate_band.GetName]§!”，并已在§H[pirate_system.GetName]§!恒星系内数次对我们不设防的贸易路线出手。我们必须尽一切努力，将这些犯罪分子绳之以法。
descriptions.en:
As civilian travel in space becomes more common place, several powerful criminal organizations on [Root.Capital.GetName] have sensed an opportunity to expand their operations. They have converted a number of civilian freighters into improvised warships, with which they raid civilian shipping lanes for booty.

We know they call themselves the "§S[pirate_band.GetName]§!" and that they have struck several times against our vulnerable trade route in the §H[pirate_system.GetName]§! system. Every effort must be made to bring these criminals to justice.

descriptions.zh:
由于觊觎我们恒星系之间不断增长的贸易，一大群源自[Root.Capital.GetName]的叛教匪徒已经将一些民船非法改造成了战争武器。这些异端自称为“§S[pirate_band.GetName]§!”，并对我们在§S[pirate_system.GetName]§!恒星系内的不设防贸易路线发起了数次袭击。

我们不能容忍他们继续这种亵渎行为！
descriptions.en:
As interstellar trade between our systems continues to grow, a large group of faithless criminals from [Root.Capital.GetName] have illegally converted a number of civilian starships into weapons of war. These heretics have started calling themselves the "§S[pirate_band.GetName]§!" and are responsible for several attacks against our vulnerable trade routes in the §S[pirate_system.GetName]§! system.

Their profane activities must not be allowed to continue!

descriptions.zh: 很可能§Y黑针§!鼓励这种非法活动，甚至可能在支持这些投机取巧的私掠者。
descriptions.en: It is likely that the §YBlack Needle§! has inspired this illicit activity, and may even be supporting these opportunistic privateers.

label.zh: 警告所有部队，开始安排战舰。
label.en: Alert all commands. Deploy the fleet.

label.zh: 这些不守规矩的人会得到报应。
label.en: These non-conformists will be dealt with.
We should be better than this.

label.zh: 我们不需要海盗这种害群之马。
label.en: Pirates. We don't need that scum.

label.zh: 一定要将他们一网打尽。
label.en: They will be brought to justice.
They must be brought back into the fold.

descriptions.zh:
一小群拥有一种罕见基因突变的子个体，可使它们切断与蜂巢思维的部分连接而不会陷入休眠。不过如果离开蜂巢思维太远，这些离群的子个体就会死亡，所以它们盘踞在了位于我们境内§H[pirate_system.GetName]§!星系。

它们打算当海盗来维持自身，利用少数简陋的飞船打劫穿越该恒星系不设防的贸易路线。
descriptions.en:
A rare genetic mutation present in a small number of drones has allowed them to partly sever their connection to the Mind without being rendered comatose. As these rogue drones would perish if they ventured too far from the Mind's influence, they have established themselves in the §H[pirate_system.GetName]§! system, within our space.

From there they intend to sustain themselves by living as pirates, using their small fleet of crude spacecraft to raid the vulnerable trade route that passes through that system.
descriptions.condition: trigger = { NOT = { has_origin = origin_storm_chasers } }

options.script: name = pirate.50.a

descriptions.zh:
[Root.GetName]报告说，舰队在[From.GetName]星系发现了很多海盗。

扫描发现海盗船和空间站的数目非常庞大，所以这应该是个历史悠久的海盗港口。这些海盗从很久以前就开始在这里进行抢劫活动，且没有遭遇过任何打击行动。
descriptions.en:
The [Root.GetName] reports that the fleet has encountered a significant pirate presence in the [From.GetName] system.

Judging by preliminary scans of the immense ships and the stations harboring them, this is a historical pirate port. It has likely been in uninterrupted operation since whatever ancient era it was that first spawned these thieving marauders.

label.zh: 海盗的存在无论对谁都是巨大的威胁。
我们去袭击他们的老窝，彻底摧毁这个威胁。
label.en: We strike at the heart of this malice.

descriptions.zh:
[killer_fleet.GetName]报告称，[killer_fleet.solar_system.GetName]星系的海盗私掠船已经被摧毁了。虽然附近恒星系中还有一些零零散散的海盗船，但从目前来看，星际海盗已经成为了过去……至少今天如此。

我们从他们丰厚的储存室里设法缴获了一批来历不明的赃物，这批宝藏我们可以纳入国库，另有他用。
descriptions.en:
The [killer_fleet.GetName] reports that the timeworn pirate galleons in the [killer_fleet.solar_system.GetName] system have been destroyed. Save for any stragglers in nearby systems, galactic piracy is a thing of the past... For now.

We were able to recover a considerable hoard of ill-gained loot from their strong room, a treasure which we promptly relocated to our own coffers.
descriptions.condition: trigger = { NOT = { has_event_chain = "l_cluster_chain" } }

descriptions.zh:
[killer_fleet.GetName]报告称，[killer_fleet.solar_system.GetName]星系中的破旧海盗船已被摧毁。不考虑邻近星系那些游民的话，星际海盗活动算是成为过去式了……至少就现在而言。

我们能从他们坚固的舱室中收回堆积满满的赃物了，其中包括一张古代数据板——令我们惊讶的是，它似乎能为神秘L-星门的运作方式提供崭新的见解。
descriptions.en:
The [killer_fleet.GetName] reports that the timeworn pirate galleons in the [killer_fleet.solar_system.GetName] system have been destroyed. Save for any stragglers in nearby systems, galactic piracy is a thing of the past... For now.

We were able to recover a considerable hoard of ill-gained loot from their strong room, including an ancient datapad which, startlingly, seems to offer fresh insights into how the mysterious L-Gates function.
descriptions.condition: trigger = { has_event_chain = "l_cluster_chain" }

descriptions.en: The [pirate_slayers.GetName] has destroyed a pirate station in the [pirate_slayers.GetStarName] system, and recovered its strong room module.

descriptions.zh: 此外，我们发现了一批属于前§Y黑针§!成员的贵重物品。
descriptions.en: Additionally, we discovered a cache of valuables belonging to former members of the §YBlack Needle§!.

descriptions.zh:
[pirate_slayers.GetName]已经消灭了位于[pirate_slayers.GetStarName]星系内的一处海盗空间站并回收了空间站的保险模块。

保险模块中除了各种被偷来的资源之外，还有某个不完整的亚空间传送门设计图的存储数据，我们不清楚海盗们是如何取得这个设计图的，但此设计图可以让我们更好的了解跨星系传送门网络的工作原理。
descriptions.en:
The [pirate_slayers.GetName] has destroyed a pirate station in the [pirate_slayers.GetStarName] system, and recovered its strong room module.

Aside from various stolen resources, the module also contained an ancient datapad with partial schematics of what appears to be a subspace Gateway. There are no records of where the pirates obtained this mysterious datapad, but it has furthered our understanding of how the galactic Gateway network functions.

descriptions.zh: 我们位于§H[pirate_system.GetName]§!星系的贸易路线没有得到很好的保护，现在近乎变成了法外之地。该恒星系已经吸引了越来越多的海盗、走私贩以及其它各种不法分子，肆无忌惮地掠夺我们的货物。
descriptions.en: Our trade route in the §H[pirate_system.GetName]§! system is poorly protected and passes through what has largely become lawless space. An increasing number of pirates, smugglers and various other criminal elements have been drawn to the system, and they now raid our shipping with near impunity.

descriptions.zh: 途经§H[pirate_system.GetName]§!星系的无防备贸易路线已经引起了一群海盗们的注意。这些匪徒集结了一支大舰队，拦截了该恒星系的大部分贸易。
descriptions.en: The unprotected trade route that passes through the §H[pirate_system.GetName]§! system has attracted the attention of a roving band of pirates. These outlaws have gathered a sizeable fleet that is intercepting much of the system's trade.

descriptions.zh: 因其贸易路线毫无防备，§H[pirate_system.GetName]§!星系已经吸引了大批不法分子，并且在最近的一次权力争夺之后，这些犯罪分子们已经有了足够的组织性，组成了一支大海盗舰队。他们利用这支东拼西凑的舰队疯狂地劫掠恒星系内的贸易船。
descriptions.en: With its vulnerable and unprotected trade route, the §H[pirate_system.GetName]§! system has attracted a large number of ne'er-do-wells, and following a recent power struggle, these criminal degenerates are now sufficiently organized to operate a significant pirate armada. They are using this ragtag fleet to intercept as much trade in the system as they can.

options.script: name = pirate.50.a

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes
is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
一小群子个体上出现了罕见的基因突变，可使它们切断与蜂巢思维的部分连接而不会陷入休眠。不过如果离开蜂巢思维太远，这些离群的子个体就会死亡，所以它们盘踞在了位于我们境内的§H[pirate_system.GetName]§!星系。

它们并不是碰巧选中的这个恒星系，而是因为我们一支最不设防的贸易路线正好途经该恒星系。那些离群的子个体无疑打算当海盗来维持生计，利用它们的少数简陋飞船打劫穿越该恒星系不设防的贸易路线。
descriptions.en:
A rare genetic mutation present in a small number of drones has allowed them to partly sever their connection to the Mind without being rendered comatose. As these rogue drones would perish if they ventured too far from the Mind's influence, they have established themselves in the §H[pirate_system.GetName]§! system within our borders.

This system was not chosen at random - one of our most vulnerable trade routes passes through it, and the rogue drones no doubt intend to sustain themselves by living as pirates, using their small fleet of crude spacecraft to raid our shipping.

options.script: name = pirate.50.a

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh: 一群外星海盗已经潜入并盘踞在了位于我们境内的§H[pirate_system.GetName]§!星系。我们有一条不设防的贸易路线途经该恒星系，它们似乎打算掠夺这条贸易路线来维持自己的犯罪活动。
descriptions.en: A group of alien pirates have infiltrated and established themselves in the §H[pirate_system.GetName]§! system, inside our space. To fund their criminal activities, they appear intent on raiding our unprotected trade route that passes through that system.

options.script: name = pirate.50.a

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes
is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh: 一小群故障的单位已经脱离了[Root.GetName]的主体智能，并躲进了我们境内的§H[pirate_system.GetName]§!星系。这些单位已经无可救药，并开始利用简陋的舰船打劫穿越该恒星系不设防的贸易路线，掠夺零件和资源。
descriptions.en: A small group of malfunctioning units have separated themselves from the main intelligence of the [Root.GetName], and sought refuge in the §H[pirate_system.GetName]§! system inside our space. These units have become irredeemably corrupted, and they now use crude spacecraft to raid the system's unprotected trade route for spare parts and resources.

options.script: name = pirate.50.a

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh: 一小群有机生物体的犯罪分子已经设法潜入并盘踞于我们境内的§H[pirate_system.GetName]§!星系。他们似乎打算打劫途经该恒星系不设防的贸易路线，或许是心存有机生物常见的侥幸心理，误以为他们的存在无关紧要，不会令我们动用武力。
descriptions.en: A small group of organic sub-units, apparently criminal outcasts, have somehow infiltrated and established themselves in the §H[pirate_system.GetName]§! system inside our borders. They seem intent on raiding the system's undefended trade route, perhaps gambling, as organics are wont to do, on the mistaken notion that they are too insignificant to warrant an armed response from us.

options.script: name = pirate.50.a

trigger: is_triggered_only = yes

descriptions.zh:
[root.GetName]代表：暂时封锁现已在[thalassocracy_target_system.GetName]生效。在此星系加工和运输的食物及矿物现在会被[thalassocracy_country.GetName]外部关卡和所得军官查封。所有非商用飞船将遭到驱逐，若执意前行则会受到炮火攻击。这些条件将一直生效，直至我们完成ECA配额。

我们理解，关卡检查有时会让人精神崩的紧紧的。只要我们相互合作，就不会有人受到伤害。请放心，我们会将正式占有的每一粒谷物和每一块矿石充分利用在[thalassocracy_species.GetName]生态居住繁殖计划中。我方对你方的贴心表示无比的感激。

亲手打造更加光明的未来！
descriptions.en:
Representatives of the [root.GetName]: a temporary blockade is now in effect at [thalassocracy_target_system.GetName]. Processing and transportation of food and minerals through this system are now subject to seizure by External Customs and Acquisitions officers of the [thalassocracy_country.GetName]. All non-merchant vessels will be turned away, or else fired upon. These conditions shall remain in effect until our ECA quotas can be met.

Sometimes these customs checks can be stressful. We understand. Co-operate, and no one need be harmed. And please, rest assured that every grain and ore we solemnly claim will be put to good use within the [thalassocracy_species.GetName] eco-hab propagation scheme. We are grateful for your consideration.

For a brighter, self-made future!
descriptions.condition: trigger = { is_regular_empire = yes }

descriptions.zh:
[root.GetName]的构造体代表：封锁现已在[thalassocracy_target_system.GetName]生效。从此以后，该区域的所有机械单位都将成为[thalassocracy_country.GetName]的臣民，为我们服务。反抗的舰队将遭到武力镇压。

我们理解此举可能会对你国造成物质上的极大不便。但我们保证，只要我们的外部关卡和所得军官达到其指定配额，我们就会停止此举措。你一定对我们这样的指令系统面临的压力能够表示理解。

在[thalassocracy_species.GetName]的生态居住繁殖图景中，你方重新编程的无人机将承担崇高的使命。亲手打造更加光明的未来！
descriptions.en:
Representative construct of the [root.GetName]: a blockade is now in effect at [thalassocracy_target_system.GetName]. Any and all machine units in this region are henceforth subjects of the [thalassocracy_country.GetName]; they will be made to service us. Resisting fleets will be fired upon.

We appreciate that this operation may represent a material inconvenience to you. We assure you that it will conclude, once our External Customs and Acquisitions officers meet their designated quotas. Surely you can understand the pressures of a directive like ours.

A worthy sense of purpose awaits your re-programmed drones within the [thalassocracy_species.GetName] eco-hab propagation scheme. For a brighter, self-made future!
descriptions.condition: trigger = { is_machine_empire = yes }

descriptions.zh:
[root.GetName]实体代表：暂时封锁现已在[thalassocracy_target_system.GetName]生效。在此星系加工和运输的食物及矿物现在会被[thalassocracy_country.GetName]外部关卡和所得军官查封。所有非商用飞船将遭到驱逐，若执意前行则会受到炮火攻击。这些条件将一直生效，直至我们完成ECA配额。

我们理解，关卡检查有时会让人精神崩的紧紧的。只要我们相互合作，就能防止你们的[root.GetIndividualNamePlural]受伤，否则，它们可能会遇到麻烦。请放心，我们会将占有的每一粒谷物和每一块矿石充分利用在[thalassocracy_species.GetName]生态居住繁殖计划中。希望你们能共同考虑此提议，我们感激不尽。

亲手打造更加光明的未来！
descriptions.en:
Representative entity of the [root.GetName]: a temporary blockade is now in effect at [thalassocracy_target_system.GetName]. Processing and transportation of food and minerals through this system are now subject to seizure by External Customs and Acquisitions officers of the [thalassocracy_country.GetName]. All non-merchant vessels will be turned away, or else fired upon. These conditions shall remain in effect until our ECA quotas can be met.

Sometimes these customs checks can be stressful. We understand. Co-operate, and no [root.GetIndividualNamePlural] need be harmed or otherwise inconvenienced. And please, rest assured that every grain and ore we claim will go to good homes within the [thalassocracy_species.GetName] eco-hab propagation scheme. We are grateful for your collective consideration.

For a brighter, self-made future!
descriptions.condition: trigger = { is_hive_empire = yes }
